verification_boundaries.catalog_mapping: A stable one-to-one mapping exists from every observed Corti pre-built Agent to a Hub-visible iCoDer Agent.
verification_boundaries.development_verified: The mapped iCoDer Pack is executable, provider-resolvable, contract-complete, example-backed, writeback-blocked and passes local runtime gates.
external_gates: independent clinical-quality benchmark on representative de-identified records
real hospital workflow and upstream/downstream integration validation
security, privacy, regulatory and clinical-governance approval
production infrastructure, observability, disaster recovery and operations validation

agents.remaining_capability_gap: Corti global coding-system breadth and same-dataset navigation quality are not independently benchmarked.

The governed local asset does not contain Includes/Excludes, Code First, Use Additional Code, Code Also, combination/sequencing rules, CPT, ICD-10-CM/PCS or authoritative China payment policy. Authoritative licensed rule assets and an independent coder benchmark remain external gates.
Payer-specific live rules, charge compliance depth and hospital claim integration remain external or incomplete.
No independent clinical coding accuracy benchmark or production catalog service SLO.

Only explicit status extraction and unique lexical catalog matches are locally verified; comprehensive procedure normalization, clinical appropriateness, authoritative catalog licensing and representative hospital benchmarking remain open.

Only explicit diagnosis labels and explicit suspected/negated/history/family-history states are locally verified. Full-note entity and symptom recall, implied-condition review, combination/sequencing/Excludes/guideline verification, authoritative catalog licensing and real de-identified chart benchmarking remain open.
No production surgical registry connector or registry-specific validation set.

The local baseline only reorganizes explicitly labelled documented facts. Corti-style EHR/device/MAR/LIS synthesis, institution-configured templates and thresholds, PubMed/DrugBank/Medical Calculator integration, APACHE II/SOFA/GCS calculation, medication screening, approval workflow, longitudinal clinical validation and independent ICU-clinician review remain unavailable or external gates.
Cannot be treated as an autonomous triage device; local protocol validation and safety approval are required.
Hospital-template coverage and specialty-specific completeness scoring need local validation.

Only exact documented-name alignment and literal allergy matching are available locally. Licensed DrugBank/hospital formulary integration, brand-generic normalization, interaction/contraindication screening, dose suitability, prescribing workflow and independent pharmacist validation remain external gates.

Automatic denial classification and root-cause inference, code/modifier/unit validation, regional payer-policy and deadline retrieval, PubMed/Web/medical-coding experts, claim/EOB/ERA integration, submission, outcome analytics and independent validation remain unavailable or external gates.

The local baseline only reorganizes explicitly labelled verbatim discharge facts. Corti-style patient-friendly medical translation, reading-level and language adaptation, conservative result explanation, medication-change explanation, PubMed/Web Search/Medical Calculator experts, EHR/AVS/patient-portal integration, accessibility/comprehension studies and prospective outcome validation remain unavailable or external gates.

Local baseline requires explicit labels and does not provide Corti-style free-text/multi-source synthesis, Medical Calculator results, live nursing/MAR/lab integration or prospective nurse handoff safety validation.
No real-time payer eligibility, policy or submission connector.
No regional referral-platform delivery or closed-loop receipt tracking.

The governed local baseline only copies explicitly labelled, user-supplied hospital-approved source statements into fixed learning-objective, key-point and open-response recall templates. Corti-style question classification, adaptive Quick/Tutor/Board-style teaching, diagnostic and mechanistic explanation, differential reasoning, drug-interaction support, PubMed/Web Search/Medical Calculator routing, source retrieval/validation, LMS integration, curriculum governance, learner-outcome validation and independent clinical-education review remain unavailable or external gates.
Corti global coding-system breadth and independent same-dataset accuracy/cost/latency parity are unverified.

The local baseline compares supplied approved-source rules and documented facts, but does not perform Corti-like configured-domain Web Search, source authenticity/currency validation, free-form multi-document synthesis, clinical applicability/significance reasoning, or an independent specialty benchmark.
Hospital CDI-team acceptance, documentation improvement outcomes and frozen benchmark parity are not complete.
